title: RSL risk-based audit referral contract and fixture
scope: Add a TAX-111-style assumed contract for audit referrals from RSL's risk-based audit system on PSRM (case reference, TIN, risk sets and scores owned by RSL, selection reason) and open a Vati investigation linked to that RSL case

acceptance.text: Contract rsl.audit_system.referral.v0-assumed with fixture records that identify themselves as fixtures; no real host, path or field name invented
A referral opens or reuses one Vati case linked to the RSL audit case reference; RSL risk-set scores are stored as RSL-owned inputs and never relabelled as Vati scores
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Contract and adapter tests; a fixture referral opens one linked case and replays idempotently

evidence.text: integration/rsl_sources/contracts.py: rsl.audit_system.referral.v0-assumed (audit_case_ref, tin, referred_on, selection_reason, optional period, risk_sets with owner RSL; unexpected fields, floats and non-RSL owners refused). Fixture integration/rsl_sources/fixtures/audit_referrals.json (fixture/synthetic, assumed-contract description, no host/path/URL); envelopes carry fixture: true and the contract notice. tests/integration/test_rsl_sources.py 10 OK; rsl_referrals/test_rules.py 9 OK (fixture read through the TAX-111 adapter, checked against the contract).

vati_tax.rsl_referrals + append-only Vati RSL Referral (ADR-047): one case per RSL audit case reference via a scoped register_case key; a second read replays and reuses the case, a changed record is a reported conflict and changes nothing; RSL risk sets/scores stored as RSL-owned inputs (owner RSL enforced by rules and controller), no finding, lane, score or decision written. Disposable verify site 2026-11-11: test_rsl_referrals_bench.py 6/6 OK (linked cases, replay, conflict, unavailable/unconfigured source, officer read, taxpayer and cross-tenant refusal, append-only, operator-only intake).

ruff, ruff format, mypy clean; validate.py ok; bench suite on a clean site with TAX-090 merged locally: 570 unit OK, site tests 1 error in reminders/test_reminders_bench (also fails on main 57499b2, unrelated).
